components.name: ecdat
components.description: Enterprise Cryptographic Discovery & Analysis Tool (SIH 2026 PS 26164)

properties.name: ecdat:recommendation
properties.value: ML-DSA-65 certificate (re-issue when the CA supports FIPS 204; hybrid/dual certificates during transition)

ratings.justification: usage is comment: not a production security control; signature/authentication use: harvest-now-decrypt-later does not apply; deadline-driven

vulnerabilities.description: ECDSA (algorithm) in mscdex/ssh2: broken; tier SAFE
vulnerabilities.detail: Elliptic-curve discrete log is broken by Shor's algorithm

ratings.justification: classically broken or below minimum strength today, independent of quantum

vulnerabilities.description: SHA-1 (algorithm) in mscdex/ssh2: legacy-broken; tier ACT_NOW
vulnerabilities.detail: Chosen-prefix collisions (SHAttered 2017, 2020); disallowed for signatures

ratings.justification: usage is test: not a production security control

vulnerabilities.description: SHA-256 (algorithm) in mscdex/ssh2: safe; tier SAFE
vulnerabilities.detail: 128-bit collision resistance holds; Grover pre-image gain is impractical

ratings.justification: classically broken or below minimum strength today, independent of quantum

vulnerabilities.description: MD5 (algorithm) in mscdex/ssh2: legacy-broken; tier ACT_NOW
vulnerabilities.detail: Practical collisions since 2004; unusable for signatures or integrity

ratings.justification: classically broken or below minimum strength today, independent of quantum

vulnerabilities.description: RC4 (algorithm) in mscdex/ssh2: legacy-broken; tier ACT_NOW
vulnerabilities.detail: Biased keystream; prohibited in TLS (RFC 7465)

ratings.justification: framework deadline 2030 is within the 3.52-year migration window

vulnerabilities.description: X25519 (algorithm) in mscdex/ssh2: broken; tier ACT_NOW
vulnerabilities.detail: Curve25519 discrete log is broken by Shor's algorithm

ratings.justification: usage is comment: not a production security control

vulnerabilities.description: 3DES (algorithm) in mscdex/ssh2: legacy-broken; tier SAFE
vulnerabilities.detail: Deprecated classically (Sweet32, 64-bit block); disallowed by NIST after 2023

ratings.justification: usage is comment: not a production security control

vulnerabilities.description: Blowfish (algorithm) in mscdex/ssh2: legacy-broken; tier SAFE
vulnerabilities.detail: 64-bit block size (Sweet32)

ratings.justification: quantum-vulnerable but short-lived data, signing-only, or ample migration time

vulnerabilities.description: AES-128 (algorithm) in mscdex/ssh2: weakened; tier MONITOR
vulnerabilities.detail: Grover reduces AES-128 to ~64-bit effective security; still NIST-approved but fails CNSA 2.0

ratings.justification: usage is test: not a production security control
